title: Shadowed rules, posture score and alerts, device posture, browser security, audit timeline

checks.what: Shadowed / catch-all / duplicate / superseded per rule type against an oracle table
Indexed comparison equals all-pairs comparison on seeded random rule sets
Large tenants compare only plausible pairs
Score, points and projection against the engine's formula
Score-drop alerts sent only when turned on; never re-reported; no network in tests
Posture families from type and name
Negated posture conditions (sense and optional)
Every isolation control and Browser Control check, severities
Version ordering of untrusted strings
Time zones in ZIA audit times
Window, newest-first limit, cut count, untimed events
Admin names only in the admin field, raw row and foreign-change reason
Own records shown only for the chosen tenant
Secrets in errors, digests and notifications
CSV exports neutralise formulas
Condition HTML escapes tenant names
Digest ids validated before naming a file
Webhook https only, redirects not followed, URL secret scrubbed
One loop run at a time
Malformed request bodies, settings files and tenant JSON never raise
Browser security and shadow rules read only ticked scopes
Secret-pair redaction is linear on adversarial input

findings.title: First-match shadow analysis compared every pair of rules (O(n²)): 3,000 firewall rules took 81 s
findings.fix: Per-criterion candidate index: each rule is compared only with rules that can cover it; same findings as all pairs

findings.title: An assessment score drop was re-reported (and re-sent) every other loop run
findings.fix: Digests carry the drops already reported forward (bounded to 20 per tenant)

findings.title: A digest e-mailed or posted for another reason carried score drops although score-drop alerts were off
findings.fix: for_notification() drops alerts whose notify is off from what leaves the machine

findings.title: A negated posture condition kept its operator when deciding whether posture is optional (DP-04 false positive / miss, wrong enforced count)
findings.fix: De Morgan: a negated condition flips AND/OR, as the plain sentence already did

findings.title: Posture type keywords matched inside words (CENTRAL_POLICY read as Entra domain join, reliable) and CROWD_STRIKE was not EDR
findings.fix: EDR/XDR/ENTRA must start a word; CROWD_?STRIKE

findings.title: Browser versions mixing words and numbers ('beta', '90') raised TypeError and ended the browser security report
findings.fix: Version key orders numbers before words without comparing int and str

findings.title: Error text hid a token value before PEM blocks, so a certificate body after a token leaked into results
Audit times with a zone abbreviation (PDT, CEST) were read as UTC, hours off, breaking the 15-minute own-write correlation
findings.fix: Table of unambiguous abbreviations; ambiguous or unknown zones are unreadable, never guessed

findings.title: score_drop raised OverflowError on an Infinity score and treated true as a score
findings.fix: Only finite non-bool numbers are scores

findings.title: A non-numeric DLP_CHECK_SMTP_PORT raised in notification_settings, ending the loop after the tenant reads with no digest
findings.fix: Port parsed with a 587 fallback and range check

findings.title: Tenant errors in the digest (connect, reads) were not scrubbed of the profile's own client secret, password or API key
findings.fix: Every tenant error is scrubbed of the profile's secrets in all encodings, failing closed

findings.title: Records naming no tenant were shown on every tenant's audit timeline (possible cross-customer disclosure)
findings.fix: Deny by default when a tenant is chosen; the page counts what was left out

findings.title: channel_coverage counts from the request that are not numbers made /api/posture/analyze and /summary answer 500; a damaged settings file or history state also raised
findings.fix: Counts, settings and states are read defensively

findings.title: List fields of tenant JSON that came back as a number, true or an object raised TypeError in the browser security normalizers and the shadow analysis
Same non-list crash in shared normalizers outside this area: ssl_flow._names, data_flow._norm_generic actions, zpa_reader.normalize_segment domainNames
findings.fix: Guard the three list reads with isinstance(list, tuple)
findings.test: tests/test_c6_posture.py::test_a_rule_whose_sub_rules_are_not_a_list_is_still_analysed (covers the in-area part; extend with dlpEngines=True after the patch)
